name: RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL
description: This table contains invoice, debit memo, bills receivable, and credit memo header information. Each row in this table includes general invoice information such as customer, transaction type, and printing instructions. One row exists for each invoice, debit memo, bill receivable, and credit memo. Invoices, debit memos, credit memos, and bills receivable are distinguished by their associated transaction types stored in the this table.

columns.name: CONTROL_COMPLETION_REASON_CODE
